about: Point it at an AI-built SaaS repo before launch. It runs the ai-saas-guard scanner (65 deterministic checks across auth, billing, tenant data access, webhooks and silent-success paths), then reads the code behind every serious finding and tells you which ones are real, which are already mitigated, and which can wait — with file and line evidence.
description: Runs the ai-saas-guard scanner and triages findings to the launch blockers.
examplePrompt: Scan this repo before launch. Run ai-saas-guard, check every critical and high finding against the code, and tell me only what would block the launch.
features: Scan auth, billing and data access for launch blockers
Verify each serious finding against the actual code
One verdict: ship, fix first, or safe to ignore
name: AI SaaS Guard
